$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (seed-kvk-source). Seeds the pre-built `kvk` OpenConnector source consumed by the OpenRegister KvK company-lookup integration leaf (KvkProvider SOURCE_ID='kvk'). Ships dormant (isEnabled:false) with the real KvK Handelsregister Zoeken API base URL and auth:apikey so a fresh install resolves the endpoint without carrying a secret. The KvK API authenticates with an `apikey` request header — operators paste their KvK API key into the source's `configuration.headers.apikey` (or the auth credential field) and flip isEnabled via the OpenConnector Sources UI. No end-user input reaches the request URL, so there is no SSRF surface (the base URL is admin-owned on the source).

objects.description: Dutch Chamber of Commerce (KvK) Handelsregister Zoeken API. Consumed by the OpenRegister KvK integration leaf (company lookup by KvK number + free-text/SBI search). Dormant placeholder — the base URL is the production KvK v2 endpoint; set your KvK API key on `configuration.headers.apikey` (the KvK API authenticates via an `apikey` request header) and enable.
